ui.waiting: Do it on the screen to go on

welcome.t: Welcome to CRP Mentor Copilot! I will guide you through the whole app.
welcome.v: Welcome to CRP Mentor Copilot. I will guide you through the whole app, step by step. Press Next to begin.

welcome_sir.t: Welcome, sir! I will guide you through the whole app.
welcome_sir.v: Welcome, sir, to CRP Mentor Copilot. I will guide you through the whole app, step by step. Press Next to begin.

welcome_maam.t: Welcome, ma'am! I will guide you through the whole app.
welcome_maam.v: Welcome, ma'am, to CRP Mentor Copilot. I will guide you through the whole app, step by step. Press Next to begin.

offpage.t: Let us go back and continue the tutorial.
offpage.v: Let us go back, and continue from where we stopped.

home_cards.t: Each card is one school. The school that needs you most comes first.
home_cards.v: These cards are your schools. They are in order. The school that needs your visit the most is at number one.

home_score.t: This number is the score, from 0 to 100. A bigger number means: visit sooner.
home_score.v: Look at this number. It is the score, from zero to one hundred. A bigger number means you should visit sooner.

home_reasons.t: These lines tell you why the score is high.
home_reasons.v: These lines tell you the reason. For example, many students are behind, or a follow-up is late.

home_switch.t: Switch here between schools and teachers.
home_switch.v: Here you can switch between schools and teachers. The list works the same way for both.

home_filters.t: Use these buttons to see only the most urgent ones.
home_filters.v: These buttons filter the list. For example, tap Critical to see only the most urgent schools.

home_open.t: Now tap this card to see its details.
home_open.v: Now, tap on this card to open its details.

detail_evidence.t: This is the evidence. It shows why this school ranks here.
detail_evidence.v: This is the evidence section. Every line here is a real record. It shows why this school is ranked here.

detail_eye.t: Tap the eye to open the file behind this record.
detail_eye.v: See this small button with an eye? Tap it to open the exact file this record came from.

detail_file.t: Here is the original file. You can check every number yourself.
detail_file.v: Here is the original file. So you can always check the data yourself. Nothing is hidden.

detail_visit.t: Tap Visit to start a visit to this school.
detail_visit.v: Now let us plan a visit. Tap the Visit button.

visit_nav.v: Let us see how a school visit works. Tap Visit in the menu.

visit_who.t: Choose a school, then tap Continue.
visit_who.v: First choose the school you are visiting. Then tap Continue.

visit_steps.t: A visit has 4 steps. We are on step 1: before class.
visit_steps.v: A visit has four easy steps. Before class, in class, students, and results. We are now on step one.

visit_teacher.t: Choose the teacher you will visit.
visit_teacher.v: First, choose the teacher you are going to visit, from this list.

visit_class.t: Choose the class and subject, and type today's topic.
visit_class.v: Now choose the class and the subject. Then type the topic being taught today.

visit_brief.t: Your briefing: what to look at, what to ask, what to watch.
visit_brief.v: This is your briefing. It tells you what to look at, what to ask the teacher, and what to watch in the class.

visit_history.t: Here you can see the past history.
visit_history.v: And here is the past history. You can see what was found earlier, and what you both agreed to do.

visit_start.v: When you are ready, tap Start the visit.

class_record.t: Step 2: in class. Record the lesson, or upload a recording.
class_record.v: Now, step two. You are in the class. Record the lesson here, or upload a recording you already have. The app turns it into text for you.

class_notes.t: Write what you saw. You can also add a photo of your notes.
class_notes.v: Here, write what you saw in the class, in your own words. You can also add a photo of your handwritten notes.

class_next.v: Good. Now tap Next, to go to the students.

students_get.v: Step three. Tap Get questions. The app writes four or five questions for today's topic. It takes a few seconds.

students_record.t: Ask a student this question and record the answer.
students_record.v: Ask a student this question. Record the answer here. Ask children from the front, the middle and the back of the class.

students_next.v: Now tap Next, to see the results.

results_wait.t: The app is preparing the results. This takes about a minute.
results_wait.v: Please wait. The app is reading everything and preparing the results. This takes about one minute.

results_short.t: Step 4: results. This is the visit in short.
results_short.v: Step four, the results. Here is the whole visit, in a few short points.

results_well.t: What went well in the class.
results_well.v: This box shows what the teacher did well. Start your talk with the teacher from here.

results_improve.t: What to improve, with one thing to try.
results_improve.v: This box shows what to improve. For each point, there is one simple thing the teacher can try.

results_steps.t: Tick the steps you agreed with the teacher.
results_steps.v: These are the next steps. Tick the ones you and the teacher agreed on.

results_followup.t: Choose when you will follow up. The usual choice is 14 days.
results_followup.v: Choose when you will follow up with the teacher. Fourteen days is the usual choice.

results_report.t: Make a short report and send it to the teacher.
results_report.v: Here you can make a short report, and send it to the teacher. The teacher gets it in the teacher app.

results_save.t: Save to records keeps this visit. Press it only for a real visit.
results_save.v: Save to records keeps this visit and updates your priority list. Press it only for a real visit, not for practice.

nav_upload.t: Now tap Upload in the menu.
nav_upload.v: Next, let us see how to add files. Tap Upload in the menu.

upload_what.t: You can add marks sheets, reports, photos of notes and recordings.
upload_what.v: Here you add your school files. Marks sheets, visit reports, attendance, photos of handwritten notes, and even recordings.

upload_drop.t: Drop files here. The app sorts them. You check, then press Import.
upload_drop.v: Drop your files in this box, or tap to choose them. The app sorts them by school and type. You only check them, and press Import.

nav_teachers.v: Now let us see how you stay in touch with teachers. Tap Teachers in the menu.

teachers_pick.v: This is the list of all your teachers. Tap on any teacher's name.

teachers_tasks.t: Give the teacher a task, or tell them the date of your visit.
teachers_tasks.v: Here you can give the teacher a task. For example, ask for the class marks. You can also tell the teacher the date of your visit.

teachers_messages.t: Send a message. The teacher reads it in the teacher app.
teachers_messages.v: Here you can send a message. The teacher reads it in the teacher app, and can reply.

teachers_review.t: The teacher's answers come here. Accept them, or ask for changes.
teachers_review.v: When the teacher sends something back, it comes here. You can accept it, or send it back for changes.

nav_ask.v: Do you have a question about your schools? Tap Ask in the menu.

ask_box.t: Type a question, or tap a ready-made one. Then tap Ask.
ask_box.v: Type your question here, in simple words. Or tap one of the ready questions. Then tap Ask. The answer comes from your own records.

nav_home.t: Tap Priorities to go back to the first page.
nav_home.v: Now let us go back to the first page. Tap Priorities in the menu.

prio_open.v: See the round button with the letter P? Tap it.

prio_sliders.t: Move a slider to decide what matters more. The list changes at once.
prio_sliders.v: These sliders decide what matters more to you. Move a slider, and the list changes at once.

prio_save.t: Save keeps your change. Reset brings back the 5 main priorities.
prio_save.v: Press Save priorities to keep your change. Press Reset any time, to bring back the five main priorities.

prio_close.t: Tap the cross to close this panel.
prio_close.v: Now tap the cross, to close this panel.

nav_settings.v: This is the last stop. Tap Settings in the menu.

settings_look.v: Here you can choose the colours you like for the app.

settings_language.t: Choose your language. This guide also speaks in that language.
settings_language.v: And here you choose your language. I can also speak to you in that language.

finish.t: Well done! You know the whole app now. Turn on Tutorial any time to see this again.
finish.v: Well done! Now you know the whole app. You can turn on this tutorial any time, from this button. All the best for your school visits!
